title: Dynamics 365 Master Planning - Simply Explained

entities.name: Mirko Peters
entities.quote: EOtem and Mirko Peters from M365 FM.

entities.name: Dynamics 365
entities.quote: This knowledge nugget is about Dynamics 365 Master Planning AU

quotes.text: The order can look possible on a spreadsheet until you place every part on a calendar.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Shows in one line why planning must combine quantities with dates.

quotes.text: Think of a spreadsheet as a photograph. It captures stock at one moment and it can be useful. Master planning is closer to a forward looking schedule because it connects quantities with dates, incoming supply and future demand.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A vivid analogy contrasting static spreadsheets with master planning.

quotes.text: So pegging, marking, and reservation give you three levels of connection. Pegging is the system's automatic match. Marking is a manual, more fixed link.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Neatly distinguishes the levels of supply-demand links.

quotes.text: But a faster answer can still be a wrong answer. Planning optimization can calculate a huge amount of connected data quickly, yet it only works from the records your business gives it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A reminder that data quality matters more than calculation speed.

quotes.text: And it definitely doesn't replace human planners. People still handle supplier risk, customer promises and exceptions, the system simply can't judge.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies the human role in automated planning.

chapters.title: Why a plan beats a spreadsheet
From one order to a supply chain
What master planning does and doesn't do

takeaways: Master planning combines demand, stock, incoming supply and production data, calculates net requirements and suggests planned orders that planners review and firm.
The bill of materials, routes and lead times let planning work backward from a customer date, while the net requirements page and pegging explain why each suggestion exists.
Planning Optimization makes runs fast and regenerative, but accurate lead times, stock and bills of materials decide whether the plan can be trusted.
hook: A customer wants 100 bicycles, but frames are late, wheels are in another warehouse and the assembly line is booked. This episode explains Dynamics 365 master planning in plain English for planners and supply chain newcomers. You will learn how demand turns into planned orders and why clean data and human judgment still matter.
